title: I Think My Account Was Hacked
steps: Stop using suspicious links or messages connected to the incident.
Use the service's official recovery/security page from a trusted device.
Change the compromised password and any reused password; sign out unfamiliar sessions.
Turn on multi-factor authentication where available.
Check recovery email/phone, forwarding rules and recent activity for changes.
Contact the affected bank or service through its independently verified fraud/support channel if money or financial credentials are involved.
avoid: Do not send recovery codes to a person who contacts you.
Do not pay an unsolicited 'recovery expert'.

title: I Gave Away My OTP, PIN or Password
steps: Treat the credential as exposed immediately.
Contact your bank/service through an official channel and explain exactly what was disclosed.
Change the exposed password and every account where it was reused.
Review active sessions, transactions and security settings.
Follow the provider's fraud and account-protection instructions.
avoid: Do not wait to see whether the attacker uses it.
Never give another code to 'undo' the first disclosure.

title: Suspicious Money Entered My Account
steps: Do not spend, withdraw or forward the unexplained funds.
Do not follow a caller's instruction to move the money to a 'safe' or different account.
Contact your bank through its official fraud/customer-service channel and report the unexpected transaction.
Keep the transaction reference, messages and other evidence.
Let the bank provide the legitimate reversal or investigation process.
avoid: Do not negotiate a private refund with a stranger.
Do not accept a commission for moving unexplained money.

title: My SIM Suddenly Stopped Working
steps: Treat an unexpected loss of mobile service as a possible security incident when it is unusual or unexplained.
Contact your network provider through an official channel as quickly as possible.
Contact your bank and important account providers through trusted channels if account alerts also appeared.
Change critical passwords from a trusted device and review recent sessions.
Monitor financial transactions and security alerts.
avoid: Do not share OTPs or verification codes with callers claiming to be support.

title: I Clicked a Suspicious Link
steps: Stop interacting with the page; do not enter additional credentials.
If you entered a password, change it through the real service using a trusted route.
If you entered financial information, contact your bank through an official channel.
If software was downloaded or installed, disconnect from sensitive services and seek trusted technical/security assistance.
Watch for new login alerts, password resets and unusual transactions.
avoid: Do not call a number shown by the suspicious page for 'support'.

title: Money Was Sent to a Scammer
steps: Contact your bank or payment provider immediately through its official fraud channel.
Give the transaction details and follow the provider's instructions about recall, dispute or account protection.
Preserve receipts, account details, messages and screenshots.
Secure the account if credentials were exposed.
Report the incident to the appropriate authority or platform where applicable.
avoid: Do not send more money to someone promising to recover the first payment.

title: My WhatsApp or Social Account Was Taken Over
steps: Warn close contacts through another trusted channel that the account may be compromised.
Use the platform's official account-recovery process.
Secure the email/phone account connected to the platform.
Review linked devices and sessions and remove anything unfamiliar.
Tell contacts not to send money or trust unusual messages from the compromised account.
avoid: Do not pay a stranger claiming they can recover the account.

title: Someone Is Threatening Me Online
steps: Do not send more money or more sensitive material just because the person threatens you.
Preserve relevant evidence such as messages, usernames, transaction details and timestamps.
Use the platform's reporting/blocking tools where appropriate.
Tell a trusted person and seek appropriate law-enforcement or specialist support when there is a credible threat.
Secure accounts and review privacy/security settings.
avoid: Do not meet an unknown person alone because they threaten you.
Do not delete the only copy of evidence before preserving it.
